defect: The fix scales srcX and srcWidth by the transfer-to-framebuffer bpp ratio in the block transfer download path.
reason: Before the change ReadFramebufferToMemory already received unscaled transfer-unit srcX and width, so the bpp mismatch the fix repairs predates this change, which only swapped width/height for srcWidth/srcHeight.

defect: The fix removes a stray semicolon after #endif that the change added.
reason: Extra tokens after #endif only produce a compiler warning, not a build failure or wrong behaviour, so the fix is a typo/style cleanup.

defect: The fix changes prevVibrationTime from int to double to match a later time_now_d based timer.
reason: At this change the cpp computed an int time (GetTimeMs() >> 6), so int was correct; the mismatch came from the later commit 886a8b1 that switched the cpp to double time_now_d().

defect: The fix only adds a needReport flag and a Reporting message with module stub debug info.
reason: The fix adds diagnostics/reporting and does not repair any behaviour of the validity checks this change added.

defect: The legacy-savestate skip buffer l4 is declared float[3] but lightangle and lightspotCoef were float[4], so old savestates are read misaligned.
reason: The change added the float l4[3] declaration and the fix changes it to float l4[4], repairing loading of older savestates; the array name l4 versus size 3 is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix multiplies the render size by the SSAntiAliasing factor.
reason: SSAntiAliasing did not exist when this file was created; the fix wires up an antialiasing option added later (41aed1a), so it is a feature completion.

defect: The fix makes SetZoom and fullscreen apply the later-added 2x SSAA factor to the render size and resizes the GPU.
reason: The fix targets the antialiasing option added after this change (41aed1a); setting renderWidth to the screen width was correct when there was no AA option.

defect: The new empty-views guard in ScrollView::ClampScrollPos sets pos to 0 but does not return, so it still reads views_[0] on an empty vector.
reason: The change added this incomplete guard while making empty ScrollViews otherwise supported, and the fix adds exactly the missing return; the fall-through is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix serializes start_time as a fixed u64 because time_t differs in size across platforms.
reason: p.Do(start_time) on a time_t was present before this change; the change only replaced DoMarker with a versioned section.

defect: numSamples is computed as unsigned (bufferSize - decodePos) while decodePos advances past bufferSize, so it underflows to a huge value, gets clamped to the max, and the loop restart branch (numSamples == 0) never triggers.
reason: The change added this decode/loop logic and the fix explicitly sets numSamples to 0 once decodePos passes the end, repairing looping; the unsigned underflow is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds int casts to silence a bool-shift warning and renames VLDM/VSTM parameters.
reason: The encoding produces the same bits after the fix; it is a warning fix and rename.

defect: The fix reads each index into a local variable before the comparisons and reformats a brace.
reason: The behaviour of GetIndexBounds is unchanged; it is a small refactor/optimization.

defect: A single audioBuffer_ is refilled and resubmitted while up to bufferCount earlier submissions of the same memory are still queued in XAudio2, which does not copy the data, causing audio glitches.
reason: The rewrite introduced the single shared buffer (the removed code even commented that SubmitSourceBuffer does not take ownership), and the fix uses a ring of bufferCount buffers.

defect: The vertical branch tests measuredWidth_ < vert.size instead of measuredHeight_ < vert.size before growing measuredHeight_.
reason: The change added the copy-pasted condition and the fix corrects exactly that comparison.

defect: ElfReader's empty destructor never frees sectionOffsets and sectionAddrs, which LoadInto allocates with new[], so every loaded ELF leaks them (members are also left uninitialized).
reason: The initial snapshot added both the allocation in ElfReader.cpp and the empty destructor; the fix initializes the pointers and adds delete[] in the destructor.

defect: The fix only reformats braces, comments and indentation in ApplyButtons.
reason: It is a style change with no behavioural effect.

defect: AlphaToPremul4444 expects an 8-bit alpha value but is passed the full 32-bit SDL pixel, so it takes bits 4-7 of the color instead of the alpha and SDL text renders wrong.
reason: The change introduced the call without >> 24 (other backends pass v >> 24) and the fix adds the shift; seeing it requires AlphaToPremul4444 in draw_text.h.

defect: The fix restructures the tess-requires-normal check and adds a D3D9 'tess not supported' rejection plus other shader text unification.
reason: The normal check this change added stays logically the same; the fix adds a new D3D9 restriction during generator unification rather than repairing these lines.

defect: The fix renames TessData fields and switches the Vulkan storage buffers to anonymous blocks so tess_data[index] matches the other generators.
reason: The named-instance-block GLSL this change emitted (tess_data.data[index]) is valid for Vulkan; the fix is part of making the unified generator output identical, not a defect repair.

defect: sceAtracSetHalfwayBufferAndGetID is given a spurious leading atracID parameter (wrapped as WrapI_IUUU), so every real argument is read from the wrong register.
reason: The change created this signature and HLE wrapper and the fix removes the atracID parameter and uses WrapI_UUU; a GetID function taking an ID contradicts its sibling sceAtracSetDataAndGetID in the same diff.

defect: The fix changes the checkbox label to 'Hardware tessellation (experimental)'.
reason: It is a UI text change warning about GLES crashes elsewhere, not a repair of this code.

defect: The fix removes static from CenterRect so StateMapping.cpp can use it for unbuffered-mode aspect ratio.
reason: Exporting the helper extends the feature to unbuffered mode; CenterRect itself is not repaired.

defect: The fix makes the lookup tables static GLushort, adds a license header and implements aspect-ratio-aware viewport in unbuffered mode.
reason: These are refactor and feature changes; the tables this change added hold correct values.

defect: The fix drops the extern table declarations (the tables became static) and adds #pragma once.
reason: It is a refactor following the tables becoming file-local; the header worked as written.

defect: mipsr4k.Reset() was moved after CoreTiming::Init() and HLEInit(), so MIPSState::Init zeroes downcount (set to INITIAL_SLICE_LENGTH by CoreTiming::Init) and other CPU state those inits set up.
reason: The change reordered the call and the fix ('Fix ordering issue') moves Reset back before CoreTiming::Init; seeing the conflict needs CoreTiming.cpp and MIPS.cpp.

defect: The fix special-cases VC_TR/VC_FL so single-element VCMP TR sets CC bits 4 and 5, and slightly optimizes the bit gathering.
reason: In this change VC_TR with n == 1 was correct via the IMUL by 0x31; the wrong VC_TR result came from d2c9919, which removed the IMUL.

defect: On Linux realpath strips the trailing slash, so path = rootNorm has no separator and DirectoryFileSystem builds paths as basePath + localpath, producing wrong host paths when mountRoot is used.
reason: The change added the mountRoot normalization and the fix appends '/' to rootNorm; seeing the problem requires realpath behaviour and DirectoryFileSystem::GetLocalPath.

defect: The fix renames ThreadContext to TaskThreadContext to avoid a debug-symbol name clash and reorders fields.
reason: The clashing struct name predates this change; the fix is a rename/reorder for debugging, not a repair of the priority-queue code.

defect: The fix drops the driver-version condition so MALI_STENCIL_DISCARD_BUG is set for all ARM Mali GPUs.
reason: The change added a workaround for some drivers where none existed; widening it after new reports is heuristic tuning, and the bug on newer drivers was not caused by this change.

defect: Root margins shift x/y by left/top but shrink w/h only by right/bottom, and the measure specs still use the unreduced size, so the root extends past the screen and buttons are cut off.
reason: The change added the margin arithmetic and the fix subtracts left+right and top+bottom from both the measure specs and the bounds.

defect: The fix requests HOST_COHERENT memory for push buffers (plus a leak fix elsewhere).
reason: This change only moved VulkanPushBuffer out of VulkanContext.h, where the HOST_VISIBLE-only request already existed.

defect: The fix also keeps lines starting with // in GetCodesList.
reason: It completes the later comment-support feature (6e67494) that skips // lines in CreateCodeList; this change's filter was fine for the format at the time.

defect: In the new SasVoice::ReadSamples PCM path, memset(output + size, 0, remaining) adds a byte count to an s16 pointer, leaving part of the buffer unzeroed garbage and possibly writing past resampleBuffer.
reason: The refactor replaced the old full-buffer memset with this mis-scaled one, and the fix rewrites the PCM read to fill the whole request in a loop with no memset.

defect: The fix changes the log category HLE to SAS, adds verbose logs, corrects the VAG loop offset and stops loops on KeyOff.
reason: The only lines from this change touched by the fix are the log category of its null-check warning; the loop bugs were in pre-existing code.

defect: The fix moves teardown into Teardown(), notifies under the thread lock, and frees cancellable and queued tasks to avoid a hang or leak.
reason: The lost-wakeup race and the leaked queued tasks predate this change, which only added the correct delete of each ThreadContext.

defect: The fix detaches destroyed framebuffers by walking fbTexInfo_ so offset-attached textures no longer keep a dangling framebuffer pointer.
reason: This change moved NotifyFramebuffer verbatim from GLES TextureCache.cpp, so the incomplete detach was pre-existing (and offset attachments came later).

defect: The fix swaps reversed MAEMO and non-MAEMO branches for ram_temp_file.
reason: The MAEMO ifdef was added by a later commit; this change only made the variable non-static.

defect: UIShader_Prepare enables blending and sets the blend func with raw glEnable/glBlendFunc, bypassing the glstate cache, so later glstate.blend/blendFunc.set calls can be skipped and game draws get the UI blend state.
reason: The change added the raw blend calls and the fix replaces them with glstate setters plus glstate.Restore(); seeing the stale cache needs the glstate caching in gl_state.h and its use in TransformPipeline.

defect: In sceFontFindOptimumFont any later font whose fields match (MATCH_GOOD) overwrites optimumFont, so the nearest-size font selected via nearestDist is lost.
reason: The change introduced this selection logic and the fix tracks nearestFont separately and prefers it.

defect: The fix moves the lastHostname assignment after the npos check in ServerHostname.
reason: This change's own bug (returning host.c_str() of a local) was already fixed by 6483b51, and reassigning the shared static lastHostname per call predates this change, so the fix does not repair this change's lines.
